name: LenticularSwitch
job: Make one photo flip to another as the angle changes, like a lenticular print built from thin vertical strips
visitor_action: move the pointer sideways across the print, drag on touch, or use the arrow keys; a slow sway hints the flip when idle
mobile: drag sideways instead of hover; a slow auto-sway hints the flip
motion: strips flip in a staggered wave following the pointer position, the print tilts slightly and a glossy glare line sweeps with it (reduced-motion: tap toggles A/B, no wave)
art_direction: Print shop: ribbed plastic sheen, vivid process-cyan and magenta photos, clean white mat, glossy glare line
